criteria.name: API page <=100 rows and <=128 KiB, default page (limit=100) only
criteria.evidence: responseBytes 35099-44103 at limit=100 only (exploratory n=200, synthetic). lib/chat-catalog.js clamps limit to 500 (CHAT_CATALOG_PAGE_MAX_LIMIT), so a limit=500 page (~190 KB / 500 rows) is NOT within the cap: cap enforcement stays OPEN (owner V1, separate todo).

criteria.name: Response <=1 MiB for list endpoints
criteria.evidence: legacy GET /api/chats returns 1499938 B at 5000 and 5372215 B at 20000 chats; unpaged endpoint still exists

criteria.name: Server-side page latency P95<=100 ms (baseline section 5 also P99<=250 ms)
criteria.evidence: P95 only: 20000 pageFirst P95 11.087 ms (rerun 10.987) <= 100 ms. P99 11.485 ms is NOT MEASURED against the P99<=250 ms budget (n=200 < 1000, exploratory).

criteria.name: Page latency before/after on identical data
criteria.evidence: No pre-change baseline exists; the re-run of the same code (08c9699) is a repeat, not before/after. Only scopeLegacy -> scopeIndexed (29.2 -> 1.7 ms) has a same-data pair.

criteria.name: Event-loop P99<100 ms / max 500 ms (app) and P99<=25 ms / max<=100 ms (storage), 1 ms resolution
criteria.evidence: Single sites within except contended locks (~53 ms), owner-lock probe (80.9 ms) and 20000-entry directory (event-loop P99 46.0, max 51.6 ms); no whole-app mixed run

criteria.name: DOM <=5000 nodes / <=300 rendered rows
criteria.evidence: The experimental entity-store path was removed; the established sidebar state and renderer remain in use. DOM nodes still need a browser (tests/e2e/sidebar-render-metrics.spec.js not run).

criteria.evidence: Legacy GET /api/chats + chatListLiveSync still exist beside /api/chats/page + chatListSyncClient, which is not wired; the established sidebar renderer remains active. Nothing retired.

criteria.name: Persist queue age budget (steady P95 <=200 ms, burst max <=2000 ms; baseline ~line 178)

criteria.name: Scope tests (durable ACK / crash / restore / scope)
criteria.evidence: Stage tests cover only owner lease, non-owner refusal, TTL failover and the read-only stub (multi-instance set) plus catalog scope lookups; durable ACK, crash and restore scope are not covered (see C12).

criteria.name: Required-vs-deferred list
criteria.evidence: V3/V5/V10 and C12 are deferred/blocked (required:false, deferred:true) consistent with DAG section 4; every other vertical and criterion is required:true. Enforced by the test.
